executionConditions.method: A separate process (scripts/vram_ballast.py, torch CUDA allocation) held 11 GiB of VRAM for the whole run. This constrains available VRAM on the same GPU; it does not reproduce a GPU with less memory (bandwidth, compute and driver behaviour are unchanged).

outputMetrics.telemetryMethod: Wall time: process spawn to exit (model load included). Device GPU: nvidia-smi every 200 ms (memory used, utilization, memory utilization, temperature, power, SM clock; includes other processes; baseline recorded before start). Process tree: working set every 500 ms and Windows "GPU Process Memory" dedicated/shared counters about once per second (lower bounds on true peaks). System: CPU utilization and used RAM every 500 ms.
